alerts.headline:
The right lane of northbound I-405 from Northeast Fourth Street (milepost 13.9) to Northeast Eighth 
Street (milepost 14.4) will be closed nightly from 9:30 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Nov. 
2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from Southeast Eighth Street (milepost 12.8) to I-90 (milepost 11) 
will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Wednesday, Nov. 4 to the morning of 
Friday, Nov. 6.

Up to two lanes of northbound I-405 from 112th Avenue Southeast/Lake Washington Boulevard 
Southeast (milepost 9) to I-90 (milepost 11) will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the 
night of Thursday, Nov. 5 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.

The Northeast 10th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., 
starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6. A signed detour will be in place.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Monday through Thursday nights, Nov. 2-5, and again from Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Thursday night, Nov. 12, eastbound I-90 ramps to northbound and southbound I-405 will close for construction. 

Signed detours will be available.

The 112th Avenue Southeast off-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., 
starting the night of Thursday, Nov. 5 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6. A signed detour will be in place.

The westbound and eastbound SR 520 on-ramps to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. 
- 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6. A signed detour will be in 
place.

The northbound I-405 off-ramps to SR 520 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. - 4 a.m., starting the night 
of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6. A signed detour will be in place.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting 
the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6. A signed detour will be in place.

The Northeast Eighth Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. – 5 a.m., 
starting the night of Wednesday, Nov. 4 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6. A signed detour will be in 
place.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Monday through Thursday nights, Nov. 2-5, and again from Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Thursday night, Nov. 12, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from Bellevue Way SE will close for bridge work.

Signed detours will be available.

Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 from Coal Creek Parkway Southeast (milepost 9.5) to North 30th 
Street (milepost 7) will be closed overnight from 10:30 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Thursday, 
Nov. 5 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.
Crews will close all lanes of northbound I-405 from SR 522 to SR 527 starting at 11 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 to 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 9. A detour route will be in place. Adjacent ramps will also close.
On SR 522 westbound just south of Hall Rd (MP 9) the 2 right lanes are closed due to roadwork.
On SR 522 eastbound just north of 96th Ave NE (MP 9) the right lane is closed due to roadwork.
The Northeast 160th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting Tuesday night, Nov. 3, to Friday morning, Nov. 6.
From 9 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 5 to 5 a.m. Friday, Nov. 6, State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from Bagwell Street to Northeast 60th Street (milepost 6) for utilities work.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.
On SR 522 eastbound at 63rd Ave NE (MP 7) the 2 right lanes are closed due to roadwork.

Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of southbound I-405 between milepost 19.84 and milepost 18.11 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.

The left express toll lane of northbound I-405 between Northeast 128th Street (milepost 21.43) and milepost 23.0 will be closed nightly from 8 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Wednesday night, Nov. 4, to Friday morning, Nov. 6.

Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of northbound I-405 between milepost 18.3 and milepost 19.85 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 between milepost 17.45 and milepost 18.12 will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6
The 70th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m. starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. - 4 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. - 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m. starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street nightly from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m. starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.
The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. - 4 a.m. starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 5 a.m. starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Saturday, Nov. 7.
Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 between milepost 18.11 and milepost 16.45 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. - 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.
On SR 522 eastbound just north of 47th Ave NE (MP 6) the 2 right lanes are closed due to roadwork.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Monday through Thursday nights, Nov. 2-5, and again from Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Thursday night, Nov. 12, the right lane of eastbound I-90 will close for bridge work.

Delays are possible through the work zone.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Monday through Thursday nights, Nov. 2-5, and again from Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Thursday night, Nov. 12, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from East Mercer Way will close for bridge work.

Signed detours will be available.

Both directions of State Route 161 in Federal Way and Milton will reduce to one lane from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly between South 370th Street and Military Road South starting Monday, Oct. 26. 

At least one lane of SR 161 in each direction will remain open through this area each night. Construction is expected to occur Monday through Thursday nights until Friday morning, Nov. 6.
Road work on SR 161 both directions at milepost 30.71 near Dechaux Rd E beginning at 7:40 am on November 5, 2026 until about 4:00 pm.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from North 30th Street (milepost 6) to Talbot Road South/SR 515 
(milepost 3) will be closed overnight from 10:30 p.m. – 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Thursday, Nov. 5 
to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 from Talbot Road South/SR 515 (milepost 3.5) to Sunset 
Boulevard North/SR 900 (milepost 5.5) will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night 
of Thursday, Nov. 5 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6.

The Northeast 44th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., 
starting the night of Monday, Nov. 2 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6. A signed detour will be in place.

The North Southport Drive/SR 900 on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 9:30 p.m. 
– 5 a.m., starting the night of Thursday, Nov. 5 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6. A signed detour will be 
in place.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to North Southport Drive/SR 900 will be closed overnight from 9:30 p.m. 
– 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Thursday, Nov. 5 to the morning of Friday, Nov. 6. A signed detour will 
be in place.

The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 44th Street will be closed overnight from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., 
starting the night of Wednesday, Nov. 4 to the morning of Thursday, Nov. 5. A signed detour will be in 
place.

From 10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 to 6 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 7, all lanes of eastbound Interstate 90 from Rainier Avenue South (milepost 3) to 77th Avenue Southeast (milepost 6) will close for maintenance. The eastbound I-90 on-ramps from Interstate 5 and Rainier Avenue South will also close. Lanes begin closing at 8:30 p.m.

From 9 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 to 6 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 7, one left lane or two right lanes of northbound State Route 99 from South Dawson Street to just south of the Alaskan Way South exit (mileposts 27-30) will close for maintenance.

Friday, Nov. 13, until the morning of Monday, Nov. 16 - Westbound SR 520 between Montlake Boulevard and I-5 in Seattle will close for construction beginning at 11 p.m. Friday until 5 a.m. Monday. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic crossing Lake Washington will exit at Montlake or Lake Washington boulevards. Those who need access to I-5 from westbound SR 520 will need to use alternate routes. Eastbound SR 520 and the SR 520 Trail are not affected by this work and will remain open.
Southbound Interstate 5 will be reduced to two lanes across the Ship Canal Bridge in Seattle for emergency pothole repair from 9 p.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, to 2 a.m. Friday, Nov. 6.

Monday, Oct. 26, on most weeknights until Friday, Nov. 13 - The westbound SR 520 off-ramp to both northbound I-5 and East Roanoke Street will close for construction on most weeknights beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. The typical closure dates are Monday through Thursday evenings, though some nights could be canceled based on needs and/or holidays. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic that remains on the bridge past Montlake and Lake Washington boulevards will detour to southbound I-5.

Saturday, Nov. 7, nightly until the morning of Monday, Nov. 9 - The eastbound SR 520 off-ramp to Montlake Boulevard in Seattle will close for construction nightly beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. During this time, all traffic from I-5 that enters eastbound SR 520 will pay the SR 520 bridge toll. Those who do not want to pay the toll or who need access to Montlake from I-5 must use alternate routes.

The right lane of westbound SR 523/Northeast 145th Street will close from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Monday, Oct. 26, through Friday, Nov. 13, from Interlaken Boulevard to Linden Avenue North for utility work.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.
Until 2 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6: Eastbound and westbound State Route 96 will alternate from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily near Lark Dairy Farm (milepost 6) for utility work.
Lowell-Snohomish River Road will alternate traffic near SR 9 beginning Wednesday, Sept. 30.
